mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with a weakening manufacturing sector (INDPRO decline > 0.1%) signals economic decoupling and increased recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (high housing starts), elevated HOUST levels signal robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and regime is high demand, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer spending, which drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 3-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A weakening manufacturing sector (INDPRO decline > 0.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals insufficient policy response to economic slowdown, increasing recession risk and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A deceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2%) signals a weakening labor market that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
